create_constraint: create a fixed joint constraint on a PyBullet URDF body using createConstraint
change_constraint: change a PyBullet constraint pivot position and orientation using changeConstraint in a loop
remove_constraint: remove an existing PyBullet constraint by its ID using removeConstraint
get_constraint_id: get a PyBullet constraint's unique ID using getConstraintUniqueId
load_urdf_and_simulate: load URDF models into a PyBullet GUI simulation with gravity and real-time enabled
